title: Reviewed business scenarios
description: Input of `generate --scenarios` and `scenarios validate`. Business flows are never guessed from paths; a human writes and reviews this file. `scenarios validate --spec` also checks it against the spec (operations, parameters, documented statuses, saved values, cleanup).

id.description: Stable external ID: the scenarioUid is derived from it, never from the title or the steps.

primary.description: Name or operationId of the action step under test.

params.description: Path and query parameters by name; "{var}" uses a value saved by an earlier step.

body.description: JSON request body; "{var}" strings are replaced by saved values.

expect.description: Documented status the step must get. Required for every phase but cleanup.

save.description: Variable → JSON pointer into the response body.
